description: shows a bicycle rear derailleur shifting gears, no chain or bike frame is shown

facts.intro: The camera frames the rear derailleur hanging from an invisible bike frame; the chain, wheels and rider are omitted, focusing on the shifting mechanism itself.
facts.cutaway: A thin cover slides upward, revealing the cage, two pulleys, the spring, and the anchor; the background remains a plain gradient, no bike parts are visible.
facts.drive: The upper pulley rotates as the shifter cable pulls, moving the cage sideways; the lower pulley stays still, showing the gear change in action.
facts.response: The spring tension releases, pulling the cage back slightly while the guide rail guides the motion; no chain tension is illustrated.
facts.hold: All moving parts pause, holding the cage in its new position; the cover stays lifted, the background stays unchanged.
facts.repeat: The shifter pulls again, repeating the same pulley rotation and cage shift; the cover does not move this time, emphasizing the internal motion.
facts.limit: The cage reaches its outermost stop against the anchor, the spring is fully compressed, and further pull does nothing; the scene still shows only the derailleur.
facts.payoff: The cover drops, the cage rests in the new gear slot, and the camera zooms out to show the complete derailleur ready for the next shift; no bike frame or chain is shown.

title: derailleur
